turns.question: What was the order cancellation rate in August 2026, as cancelled amount divided by total order amount, not the average of daily cancellation rates?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no value-based cancellation rate; the one cancellation rate is the share of orders cancelled (by count, over the whole period), which was 8.33 % for 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
